授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
本講義は、浮選技術の基礎に関する講義と、学生主体の学術論文レビューおよび討論を組み合わせて実施する。授業は英語を中心に行い、必要に応じて日本語による補足説明を行う。
The course combines fundamental lectures on flotation technology with student-led scientific paper reviews and discussions. Classes will be conducted primarily in English, with supplementary explanations in Japanese when necessary.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
本講義では、鉱物処理、資源リサイクルおよび環境修復における浮選の基本原理、先端技術および多様な応用について学ぶ。浮選機構、鉱物表面化学、浮選試薬および分離性能に影響する諸因子について理解を深めるとともに、硫化鉱物、酸化鉱物、重要鉱物資源、炭素質材料および使用済みリチウムイオン電池などの二次資源を対象とした浮選技術について学習する。また、古紙再生、排水処理および環境修復など、鉱物処理以外の分野における浮選の応用についても取り上げる。
講義は、浮選の基礎に関する講義と、学生主体の学術論文レビューを組み合わせて実施する。文献調査、発表および討論を通じて、浮選研究を批判的に評価し、実験結果を解釈するとともに、先端浮選技術の応用可能性や研究課題を検討する能力を養う。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
This course introduces the fundamental principles, advanced technologies, and diverse applications of froth flotation in mineral processing, resource recycling, and environmental remediation. Students will develop an understanding of flotation mechanisms, mineral surface chemistry, flotation reagents, and factors influencing separation performance. The course covers the flotation of sulfide and non-sulfide minerals, critical mineral resources, carbonaceous materials, and secondary resources such as spent lithium-ion batteries. Applications of flotation in paper recycling, wastewater treatment, and environmental remediation will also be discussed.
The course combines fundamental lectures with student-led reviews of scientific literature. Through independent literature investigation, presentations, and group discussions, students will develop the ability to critically evaluate flotation research, interpret experimental results, and identify potential applications and research challenges in advanced flotation technology.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Froth flotation, Mineral processing, Surface chemistry, Sulfide minerals, Non-sulfide minerals, Critical minerals, Resource recycling, Lithium-ion batteries, Environmental remediation
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
資源処理、化学または関連する工学分野の基礎知識を有することが望ましい。浮選研究の経験は必須としない。英語で書かれた学術論文を読み、発表および討論に積極的に参加することが求められる。
Basic knowledge of mineral processing, chemistry, or related engineering fields is recommended. Prior experience in flotation research is not required. Students are expected to read scientific articles written in English and actively participate in presentations and discussions.

授業科目の実施方法について.テキスト: No designated textbook is required. Lecture materials and relevant scientific articles will be provided or introduced through Moodle.
授業科目の実施方法について.参考書等:
Wills, B. A. and Finch, J. A., Wills' Mineral Processing Technology: An Introduction to the Practical Aspects of Ore Treatment and Mineral Recovery, 8th Edition, Butterworth-Heinemann, 2016.
Additional references include peer-reviewed scientific articles on flotation published in journals such as Minerals Engineering, International Journal of Mineral Processing, Separation and Purification Technology, Powder Technology, and Applied Surface Science.

授業科目の実施方法について.備考: The course consists of two fundamental lectures and six student-led scientific literature review sessions. Presentation schedules and assigned topics will be adjusted according to the number of enrolled students. Students are expected to independently search for scientific articles and actively participate in presentations and discussions.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考: The final grade will be determined based on scientific paper presentations (40%), written critical reviews (35%), and contributions to scientific discussions (25%). No final written examination will be conducted.

授業科目に関する学習相談について.担当教員による学習相談:
授業内容、学術論文の選定、発表準備および研究に関する相談を受け付ける。相談を希望する学生は、事前にメールで担当教員に連絡し、日時を調整すること。
Students may contact the instructor by email to arrange individual consultations. Questions regarding lecture contents, scientific paper selection, presentation preparation, and research-related discussions are welcome. Consultation appointments should be arranged in advance.
